title: NTA UGC NET December 2024 E Certificate Download
documentsRequired: Application number, roll number, DOB, registered email/mobile
howToApply:
1. Visit https://ugcnet.nta.nic.in
2. Open e-Certificate archive / download
3. Login with December 2024 application credentials
4. Download certificate PDF
5. Verify via DigiLocker if issued there
shortDescription: NTA UGC NET December 2024 E-Certificate Download – get digital NET certificate from NTA UGC NET portal.
content:
Qualified candidates of UGC NET December 2024 can download their e-certificates from the NTA UGC NET website.

Use application number and date of birth. The e-certificate is accepted for Assistant Professor eligibility and JRF as mentioned on the document.
